senses.gloss: Datta, n. of a rich householder at Śrāvastī, father of Sudatta = Anāthapiṇḍada: MSV 〔iii.133.13 ff.〕
Dattā, n. of a yakṣiṇī: Sādh 〔561.1, 11〕.

? Dattrima-daṇḍika-putra, patron. of Rājaka: LV 〔238.10〕; Lefm. with most mss. Datṛma˚; Calc. Trima˚, with v.l. Dattrima˚; form and mg. of first element obscure. Tib. gdul baḥi be con can gyi bu, son of one who has a stick for discipline.
